Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q4 2020 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of MA.
We generated $14.9 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
We believe the pipeline is strong, but conversion timing remains uncertain given customer budget cycles.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q4 2020.
Our gross margin expanded by 55 basis points to 51.5%, reflecting improved operational efficiency.
We anticipate margins may be impacted by approximately 55 basis points pending supplier contract renewals.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
Are you seeing any signs of demand elasticity in your enterprise segment?
Thank you for the question. We delivered record revenue of $16.0 billion this quarter, representing 18% year-over-year growth.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Revenue guidance of $16.0 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
